'''Edrii''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vice-Commandant]] of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was among those who were bought off by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] prior to the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. However, as the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] came dangerously close to destruction, Regulators found less and less reasons to remain on the surface. Edrii and the others were paid extra by the [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] to stay, even as most of the civilian and Republic forces were evacuated. Szajin promised to prove that Makeb was stabilized, but was confronted and defeated by the Imperial hero who worked with [[Katha Niar]] to save the planet.<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />

{{GameDS}}
To prevent the Regulators leaking information about the Empire's involvement, they used their laser drills to bury the mercenaries in magma and rubble. Edrii was last seen ordering her troops to find shelter.<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />
{{Endgame}}
